title: UMass PCL at SemEval-2022 Task 4: Pre-trained Language Model Ensembles for Detecting Patronizing and Condescending Language
reasoning: The paper describes a system designed to detect patronizing and condescending language (PCL). While the task and datasets used (such as Stereoset and BiasCorp) touch upon social biases and stereotypes, the paper does not specifically evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, or moral/ethical frameworks. Mentions of religious beliefs in the text are incidental examples within the dataset.
